newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha swaps firm, but physical side dull.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha swaps firm, but physical side dull.

text.p: NWE naphtha was a mixed bag pricewise on Thursday with strength in swaps levels not confirmed by activity on the physical market, traders said.
On the swaps front, May paper was pegged around $185/$186.50, while June paper was assessed around $188.00/$189.00.
Many traders were perplexed by the higher swaps level, saying it was not reflected by strength on the physical markets.
"I see no reason for swaps to be stronger," one trader said.
Full-range cargoes were pegged around $180 cif NWE for May delivery.
